Strong leadership experience: Managed a large team (50+ reports, 4 directors) post-acquisition at prior company.

Mixed signals on Sanity experience: Claimed lack of pull, yet 70% of revenue came from PLG signups—raises questions about how he interprets GTM dynamics.
Limited insight into outbound: Only 10% of revenue at Sanity came from outbound, which could indicate less experience building outbound-heavy motions.
